_comment: The town behind the wardrobe. Lines marked PROPOSED in the bible are its earlier wording, carried over; lines marked NEW are this build's, for the owner to rewrite. Nobody in the town talks back like a person: the monsters were people, and Kurt can talk to them once he knows who they were.

steer_2.speaker: socko
steer_2.text: Keep going. Don't read the signs.

steer_3.speaker: socko
steer_3.text: You don't need to see that. Gun first.

nuggets.speaker: socko
nuggets.text: Ooh, shiny. Grab those. Grab all of those.

gun.speaker: socko
gun.text: Ooh. Now we're talking. You know what that's for.

gun_hint.speaker: socko
gun_hint.text: Hold it up to your eye, then squeeze. Don't yank. Squeeze.

reloaded.speaker: socko
reloaded.text: Look at you go. Did you see your hands? I didn't teach you that.

empty.speaker: socko
empty.text: Click. That's the sad noise. Load it.

enough.speaker: socko
enough.text: You've got enough. Headshot. Trust me.

bought_headshot.speaker: socko
bought_headshot.text: There we go. Now we're friends.

marta_here.speaker: socko
marta_here.text: There she is. Don't think. Aim for the head.

caught.speaker: socko
caught.text: Up. Up. She's had her go. Now we have ours.

caught_other.speaker: socko
caught_other.text: Up you get. That one's got a grip on it, huh?

marta_dead_2.speaker: socko
marta_dead_2.text: What? It's a... word. Come on.

talked.speaker: socko
talked.text: ...Huh. Okay. We're talking to them now. Great. Love that for us.

loop_kurt.speaker: kurt
loop_kurt.text: Same chalk circle. Same cobbles. This street goes on forever, and it's thirteen houses long.

loop_socko.speaker: socko
loop_socko.text: Streets are like that. Keep walking.

senses.speaker: kurt
senses.text: She's close. Don't ask me how I know.

gate_seen.speaker: socko
gate_seen.text: Ooh, a gate! Gates go places.

gate_shut.speaker: socko
gate_shut.text: Lever. On the post. Pull the lever, bud.

out_kill.speaker: socko
out_kill.text: See? Easy. My way's the easy way.

out_talk.speaker: socko
out_talk.text: Talking. You talked us out. Next time, we do it my way.

out_sneak.speaker: socko
out_sneak.text: Sneaky. I like sneaky. I'd like it more with bang.

count.speaker: girl
count.text: ...семь, восемь, девять, десять. Я иду искать.

photo.title: A photograph
photo.text: A studio portrait. A big bearded man in a peasant's shirt, his hand on the head of a young woman who looks straight at the camera.
photo.socko: Old photo. Dead people. Come on.

g_note.title: A note, folded small
g_note.text: You saw the river. You told me first.  — G.
g_note.handwriting: The folds are hers, small enough for a glove. She had it on her the night you met her.
g_note.socko: Don't read other people's mail, bud.

paper.title: Petrogradskaya Gazeta, December 1916
paper.text: The front page is about a body found in the river.
paper.handwriting: In the margin, in her pencil: «Told him.»

poster.title: A poster
poster.text: THE CHAMPION'S LEAGUE. A man in a domino mask, a bow drawn, an arrow on the string. TRICKSHOT.
poster.socko: Huh. Some fella. Gun's that way.

mask.title: A domino mask
mask.socko: Nope. Not your colour. Put it down.

register.title: The hotel register
register.text: Room four. Two names, the second in the same hand as the first: T., and M. Sokolova.
register.handwriting: Both in her hand. You never signed for anything. The porter carried her case up, and never said a word about it.

strip.title: A photo-booth strip
strip.text: Four frames. A man and a woman, laughing at something off to the side.
strip.handwriting: On the back: «T. and me. The last good night.»

quiver.title: A quiver
quiver.text: Leather, worn pale where it rubbed a shoulder. Empty.
quiver.socko: Arrows? We're past arrows. We've got a gun.

glasses.title: Two glasses
glasses.text: One with lipstick on the rim.
glasses.socko: Somebody had a nice night. Come on.

drawing.title: A child's drawing
drawing.text: MAMA, big, and a small man with a bow walking off the edge of the paper.
drawing.handwriting: On the back: «She asked me where he went. I said far.»

letters.title: Letters
letters.handwriting: The P of PAPA is made the way you make yours. You showed her how.

lamps.title: A lamplighter's tally, chalked on a post
lamps.text: Thirteen strokes, rubbed out. Thirteen strokes, rubbed out. Thirteen strokes.
lamps.socko: Somebody can count. Good for them.

porter._note: NEW: who he was, his words, Kurt's, are this build's
porter.hint: He keeps saying a room number. Somewhere in this town it's written down who had that room.
porter.kurt: Room four. That was us. You carried her case up the stairs and you never said a word. It's alright. Nobody's coming down.

lamplighter.hint: He counts lamps. He'd need someone who knows how long this street really is.
lamplighter.kurt: It's thirteen. That's all of them. They're lit. You can stop now.

marta._note: NEW. Her fragments are the bible's.
marta.hint: She knows you. You'd have to know who you were to her.
